title: The plain graph on the Work across projects card
goal: The card shows the dependency graph in swimlanes with the critical path and slack; a node opens its record
acceptance: The card has a Graph view beside the existing list, with a switch for lanes by who acts or per repository; critical path and slack as the component draws them; a node click opens a panel with the record or step, its estimate and recorded actual hours, and the source link at its commit
Labels in both voices and both languages the card already has; tokens only; narrow width shows the text list
Browser test across the API and the built card with a fake index: both lane switches, node click and source link, the unreachable state, phone width, axe
The plain look is the default in Simple and in Eva until T04
privacy: Neutral invented data only; no personal data, tokens or private reports in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: One card section that places bx-work-graph on data the API already serves; read docs/STYLE-GUIDE.md and docs/agents/angular.md first. Estimated 2026-11-27. Not a measurement.
